extracted.intended_audience: users of the SINGULAR computer algebra system; mathematicians and programmers working with Chern class computations and algebraic geometry using the chern.lib library
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for procedures in the chern.lib SINGULAR library: each entry lists usage, return type, purpose, notes and examples for computing Chern classes/roots, Todd class, Schur polynomials, partitions, Segre/Fulton/CSM classes, and related combinatorial helpers.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChernRootsSum
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: ChernRootsSum(a, b); a, b lists of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern roots of the direct (Whitney) sum of a vector bundle with Chern roots a and a vector bundle with Chern roots b.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note and Example: shows typical invocation with lists a(1..3), b(1..2) and the resulting list of roots [a(2), a(1), a(3), b(1), b(2)].

rubrics_metrics.name: chSum
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chSum(c, C); c, C lists of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern classes of a direct sum of two vector bundles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Given c(1..3) and C(1..2) returns the Chern classes of their direct sum; sample output lists degree-wise expressions (e.g., c(1)+C(1), c(2)+c(1)*C(1)+C(2), etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: ChernRootsDual
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: ChernRootsDual(l); l a list of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern roots of the dual vector bundle of a vector bundle with Chern roots from l.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: input a(1..3) returns [-a(1), -a(2), -a(3)].

rubrics_metrics.name: chDual
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chDual(c); c list of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the list of Chern classes of the dual vector bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: input c(1..3) returns Chern classes of the dual bundle such as [-c(1), c(2), -c(3)].

rubrics_metrics.name: ChernRootsProd
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: ChernRootsProd(a, b); a, b lists of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern roots of the tensor product of a vector bundle with Chern roots a and a vector bundle with Chern roots b.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: with a(1..2), b(1..3) returns all pairwise sums a(i)+b(j) (sample ordering given).

rubrics_metrics.name: chProd
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chProd(r, c, R, C [, N]); r, R polynomials (integers); c, C lists of polynomials, N integer. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the list of Chern classes of the product (tensor product) of two vector bundles in terms of their ranks and Chern classes (up to degree N).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example outputs for ranks 3 and 2 illustrate degree-wise Chern classes; also shows use with N to compute only first two classes on a surface. Note: general-purpose implementation; examples give explicit polynomial expressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: chProdE
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chProdE(c, C); c, C lists of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the list of Chern classes of the product (tensor product) of two vector bundles in terms of their Chern classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: makes sense only for lists of polynomials; uses elimination so is very inefficient; included only for comparison with chProd(...). Example given with explicit (inefficient) output (signs differ from chProd outputs).

rubrics_metrics.name: chProdL
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chProdL(r, c, R, C); r, R integers; c, C lists of polynomials. Return: list. Purpose: computes the list of Chern classes of the product of two vector bundles in terms of their Chern classes using Lascoux's formula (Schur polynomials via the second Jacobi-Trudi formula).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: shows outputs for rank 3 vs rank 1 case; intended to implement the Lascoux formula and compute Schur polynomials via Jacobi-Trudi.

rubrics_metrics.name: chProdLP
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chProdLP(r, c, R, C); r, R integers; c, C lists of polynomials. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the total Chern class of the product of two vector bundles in terms of their ranks and Chern classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Implementation of the formula of Lascoux; Schur polynomials via second Jacobi-Trudi. Example: returns the total Chern class polynomial (1 + ... ) for rank 3 and rank 1 case.

rubrics_metrics.name: chProdM
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chProdM(r, c, R, C); r, R integers; c, C lists of polynomials. Return: list. Purpose: computes the list of Chern classes of the product of two vector bundles in terms of their Chern classes using Manivel's formula.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: shows output for rank 3 vs rank 1 giving degree-wise classes; alternative implementation (Manivel).

rubrics_metrics.name: chProdMP
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chProdMP(r, c, R, C); r, R integers; c, C lists of polynomials. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the total Chern class of the product of two vector bundles in terms of their ranks and Chern classes (implementation following Lascoux/Jacobi-Trudi).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: returns total Chern class polynomial identical to chProdLP's example; note on implementation details given.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChernRootsHom
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: ChernRootsHom(a, b); a, b lists of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: for a vector bundle E with Chern roots a and a vector bundle F with Chern roots b, computes the Chern roots of Hom(E, F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: with a(1..2), b(1..3) returns [-a(i)+b(j)] for all pairs (i,j) ordered explicitly in examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: chHom
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chHom(r, c, R, C [, N]); r, R polynomials (integers); c, C lists of polynomials, N integer. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes (up to degree N) the list of Chern classes of the vector bundle Hom(E, F) in terms of the ranks and the Chern classes of E and F.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: gives degree-wise outputs for rank 3 vs rank 2 case; also shows formula for first two Chern classes on surfaces. Use rHRR-like patterns for building classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChernRootsSymm
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: ChernRootsSymm(m, l); m integer, l a list of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern roots of the m-th symmetric power of a vector bundle with Chern roots from l.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: second symmetric power (m=2) of a rank-3 bundle returns roots like a(i)+a(j) and 2*a(i) where appropriate; sample outputs provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChernRootsWedge
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: ChernRootsWedge(m, l); m integer, l a list of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern roots of the m-th exterior power of a vector bundle with Chern roots from l.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: makes sense only for list of polynomials. Example: second exterior power of rank-3 returns pairwise sums a(i)+a(j) as shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: chSymm
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chSymm(k, r, c[, pos]); k, r integers, c list of polynomials, pos list of integers. Return: list with entries: int N, list of polynomials l. Purpose: computes the rank and the Chern classes of the symmetric power of a vector bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: for second symmetric power, chSymm2L could be faster. Examples show returned rank and first Chern classes for various ranks; sample outputs include rank 6 for chSymm(2,3,...) and many polynomial expressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: chSymm2L
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chSymm2L(r, c); r integer, c list of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern classes of the second symmetric power of a vector bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Implementation via Lascoux; Schur polynomials via Jacobi-Trudi. Example: for rank 2 returns rank 3 and classes like 2*c(1)^2+4*c(2), 3*c(1), etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: chSymm2LP
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chSymm2LP(r, c); r integer, c list of polynomials. Return: poly. Purpose: computes the total Chern class of the second symmetric power of a vector bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: for rank 2 returns polynomial 1+3*c(1)+2*c(1)^2+4*c(2)+4*c(1)*c(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: chWedge
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chWedge(k, r, c [,pos]); k, r integers, c list of polynomials, pos list of integers. Return: list with entries: int N, list of polynomials l. Purpose: computes the rank and the Chern classes of the exterior power of a vector bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: for second exterior power chWedge2L(...) could be faster. Examples show rank and Chern classes for second exterior power of rank-3 and fourth exterior power of rank-5 with explicit polynomial outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: chWedge2L
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chWedge2L(r, c ); r integer, c list of polynomials. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the Chern classes of the second exterior power of a vector bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Implementation of Lascoux formula with Schur polynomials via Jacobi-Trudi. Example for rank 3 returns rank 3 and classes like c(1)*c(2)-c(3), c(1)^2+c(2), 2*c(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: chWedge2LP
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chWedge2LP(r, c ); r integer, c list of polynomials. Return: poly. Purpose: computes the total Chern class of the second exterior power of a vector bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: for rank 3 returns 1+2*c(1)+c(1)^2+c(2)+c(1)*c(2)-c(3).

rubrics_metrics.name: todd
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: todd(l [, n] ); l a list of polynomials, n integer. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes [the first n] terms of the Todd class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: returns an empty list if l is empty. Examples: Todd class terms up to degree 5 in terms of c(1..5) are shown; calling todd(l,2) returns first two terms; sample outputs include 1/2*c(1), 1/12*c(1)^2+1/12*c(2), 1/24*c(1)*c(2), etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: toddE
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: toddE(l); l a list of polynomials. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the highest relevant term of the Todd class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: returns an empty list if l is empty; very inefficient because elimination is used; included for comparison with todd(c). Examples: for l=c(1) returns 1/2*c(1); for l=c(1..2) returns -c(1)^2-c(2); for l=c(1..3) returns -c(1)*c(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bern
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: Bern(n); n non-negative integer. Return: list of numbers. Purpose: computes the list of (second) Bernoulli numbers from B(0) to B(n).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: needs a base ring to be defined; returns an empty list if n is negative; uses the Akiyama-Tanigawa algorithm. Example: Bern(9) returns first 10 Bernoulli numbers with outputs like 1, 1/2, 1/6, 0, -1/30, 0, 1/42, ... .

rubrics_metrics.name: tdCf
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: tdCf(n); n integer. Return: list of rational numbers. Purpose: computes up to degree n the coefficients of the Todd class of a line bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: tdCf(4) returns list [1, 1/2, 1/12, 0, -1/720].

rubrics_metrics.name: tdTerms
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: tdTerms(n, f); n integer, f polynomial. Return: list of polynomials. Purpose: computes the terms of the Todd class of the line bundle with the Chern root f up to degree n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: tdTerms(4, t) on a line bundle with Chern root t returns [1, 1/2 t, 1/12 t^2, 0, -1/720 t^4].

rubrics_metrics.name: tdFactor
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: tdFactor(n, a); n integer, a polynomial. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes up to degree n the Todd class of the line bundle corresponding to the Chern root t.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: returns 0 if n is negative. Example: tdFactor(4, t) returns 1+1/2 t + 1/12 t^2 - 1/720 t^4.

rubrics_metrics.name: cProj
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: cProj(n); n integer. Return: list of integers. Purpose: computes the terms of positive degree of the total Chern class of the tangent bundle on the complex projective space P^n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: cProj(1) returns [2]; cProj(2) returns [3,3]; cProj(3) returns [4,6,4].

rubrics_metrics.name: chProj
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chProj(n); n integer. Return: list of (rational) numbers. Purpose: computes the terms of the Chern character of the tangent bundle on the complex projective space P^n.

rubrics_metrics.name: tdProj
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: tdProj(n); n integer. Return: list of (rational) numbers. Purpose: computes the terms of the Todd class of the (tangent bundle of the) complex projective space P^n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example outputs: tdProj(1) -> [1,1]; tdProj(2) -> [1,1,1]; tdProj(3) -> [1,2,3/2,11/6,1] (sample shown).

rubrics_metrics.name: eulerChProj
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: eulerChProj(n, r, c); n integer, r polynomial (or integer), c list of polynomials. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the Euler characteristic of a vector bundle on P^n in terms of its rank and Chern classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: For P^1 returns r + c(1); for P^2 returns r + 3/2*c(1) + 1/2*c(1)^2 - c(2); for P^3 returns r + 11/6*c(1) + c(1)^2 - 2*c(2) + 1/6*c(1)^3 - 1/2*c(1)*c(2) + 1/2*c(3). Also notes: if bundle is framed at subplane (c(1)=c(2)=0), eulerChProj(3, r, [0,0,c(3)]) = r + 1/2*c(3), implying c(3) must be even in this case.

rubrics_metrics.name: chNumbersProj
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chNumbersProj(n); n integer. Return: list of integers. Purpose: computes the Chern numbers of the projective space P^n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: chNumbersProj(2) -> [9,3]; chNumbersProj(3) -> [64,24,4].

rubrics_metrics.name: classpoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: classpoly(l, t); l list of polynomials, t polynomial. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the polynomial in t with coefficients being the entries of l.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: given l=c(1..5) returns c(1)*t + c(2)*t^2 + ... + c(5)*t^5.

rubrics_metrics.name: chernPoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chernPoly(c, t); c list of polynomials, t polynomial. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the Chern polynomial in t (same as toddPoly(...)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: for c(1..5) returns 1 + c(1)*t + c(2)*t^2 + ... + c(5)*t^5.

rubrics_metrics.name: chernCharPoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: chernCharPoly(r, ch, t); r polynomial, ch list of polynomials, t polynomial. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the polynomial in t corresponding to the Chern character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: with ch(0..5) returns r + ch(1)*t + ch(2)*t^2 + ... as polynomial representing the Chern character.

rubrics_metrics.name: toddPoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: toddPoly(td, t); td list of polynomials, t polynomial. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the polynomial in t corresponding to the Todd class (does the same as chernPoly(...)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: toddPoly(td(1..5), t) returns 1 + td(1)*t + td(2)*t^2 + ... + td(5)*t^5.

rubrics_metrics.name: rHRR
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: rHRR(N, ch, td); N integer, ch, td lists of polynomials. Return: polynomial. Purpose: computes the main ingredient of the right-hand side of the Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch (HRR) formula.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: to get the RHS of HRR one needs to be able to compute the degree of the output. Example: given ch(0..3) and td(0..3) for a 3-fold, rHRR(3, c, t) returns td(3)*ch(0) + td(2)*ch(1) + td(1)*ch(2) + td(0)*ch(3).

rubrics_metrics.name: SchurS
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: SchurS(I, S); I list of integers representing a partition, S list of polynomials. Return: poly. Purpose: computes the Schur polynomial in the Segre classes S (of the dual vector bundle), i.e., in the complete homogeneous symmetric polynomials, with respect to the partition I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: if S are the Segre classes of the tautological bundle on a Grassmannian, this gives the cohomology class of a Schubert cycle. Example: for partition (1,2,4) and S=s(1..6) returns s(1)*s(2)*s(4)-s(1)^2*s(5)-s(3)*s(4)+s(1)*s(6), and comparison with SchurCh is shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: SchurCh
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: SchurCh(I, C); I list of integers representing a partition, C list of polynomials. Return: poly. Purpose: computes the Schur polynomial in the Chern classes C, i.e., in the elementary symmetric polynomials, with respect to the partition I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: if C are the Chern classes of the tautological bundle on a Grassmannian, this gives the cohomology class of a Schubert cycle. Example: partition (1,2,4) and C=c(1..3) returns c(1)^2*c(2)*c(3)-c(2)^2*c(3)-c(1)*c(3)^2; compared to SchurS with Segre classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: part
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: part(m, n); m positive integer, n non-negative integer. Return: list of lists. Purpose: computes all partitions of integers not exceeding n into m non-negative summands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: if n is negative or m is non-positive, the list with one empty entry is returned. Examples show partitions into 3 summands of numbers not exceeding 1, with various printed lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: dualPart
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: dualPart(I [,N]); I list of integers, N integer. Return: list of integers. Purpose: computes the partition dual (conjugate) to I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: result is extended by zeroes to length N if optional N provided and computed dual partition is shorter. Example: dual of (1,3,4) returns [1,2,2,3].

rubrics_metrics.name: PartC
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: PartC(I, m); I list of integers, m integer. Return: list of integers. Purpose: computes the complement of a partition with respect to m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: returns the zero partition if the maximal element of the partition is smaller than m. Example: complement of (1,3,4) with respect to 5 returns [1,2,4].

rubrics_metrics.name: partOver
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: partOver(n, J); n integer, J list of integers (partition). Return: list of lists. Purpose: computes the partitions over a given one with summands not exceeding n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: partitions over (3,3,4) with summands not exceeding 4 produce a list of partitions displayed in examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: partUnder
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: partUnder(J); J list of integers (partition). Return: list of lists. Purpose: computes the partitions under a given one.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: partitions under (0,1,1) are shown; printed outputs illustrate enumerated partitions under the given partition.

rubrics_metrics.name: SegreA
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: SegreA(I); I an ideal. Return: list of integers. Purpose: computes the Segre classes of the subscheme defined by I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: in P^3 with ideal I=xy, xz, yz (3 non-coplanar lines through a point) SegreA(I) returns [0,0,3,...]; for coplanar lines example J gives negative integers as higher-degree terms (-10, -12) illustrating sensitivity to geometry.

rubrics_metrics.name: FultonA
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: FultonA(I); I an ideal. Return: list of integers. Purpose: computes the Fulton classes of the subscheme defined by I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: in P^3, for non-coplanar lines I=xy,xz,yz FultonA(I) returns [0,0,3,2]; for coplanar lines J=w, x*y*(x+y) FultonA(J) returns [0,0,3,0]. Examples compare SegreA and FultonA outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: CSMA
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: CSMA(I); I an ideal. Return: list of integers. Purpose: computes the Chern–Schwartz–MacPherson (CSM) classes of the variety defined by I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: demonstrated on the projective plane with a smooth cubic ideal I = x^3 + y^3 + z^3; example invocation setup provided (ring r = 0, (x,y,z), dp) though full numeric outputs not shown in this chunk.
